title: Jack Dorsey’s Block made an AI model that talks to you like an awkward new friend
hook_text: Dessa talks like an awkward friend
script:
Block just released an AI model called Dessa.
It mimics human conversation by training exclusively on human chat logs.
Dessa lead Ragavan Thurairatnam shared early tests of the model.
The results often sound like an awkward new friend.
This model follows Jack Dorsey's vision for human-centric communication tools.
Dessa is catching people off guard with its uncanny responses.
Would you keep talking to a bot that sounds this weird?
